name: pnp-copilot-pro-dev-da-zava-mcp-openapi-sdk
title: Zava Insurance MCP Declarative Agent with OpenAPI SDK
shortDescription: A Declarative Agent that wraps a Zava Insurance MCP Server into a Microsoft 365 Copilot agent using the Agents Toolkit (ATK) in VS Code. Instead of hand-authoring an OpenAPI spec, ATK points at the MCP discovery URL and generates all manifests, wiring in authentication and function definitions automatically. The agent enables insurance claims management including viewing claims dashboards, claim details, managing inspections, contractors, and purchase orders.
longDescription: This sample demonstrates how to wrap an existing MCP (Model Context Protocol) Server into a Microsoft 365 Copilot Declarative Agent using the Agents Toolkit (ATK) in VS Code. The Zava Insurance MCP agent provides insurance claims management capabilities including displaying claims dashboards with status overview and filters, viewing detailed claim information, creating and updating inspections, managing contractors, and handling purchase orders. Instead of hand-authoring an OpenAPI spec, you point ATK at your MCP discovery URL and let the toolkit generate all manifests, wiring in authentication and function definitions automatically.
